comment: Required production TLS posture, not a claim that every edge complies. Live probes must distinguish explicit peer rejection from client/network errors. The default-certificate CloudFront edge accepted TLS 1.0/1.1 on 2026-10-16; keep its required minimum at TLS 1.2 so the gate remains failing until the edge is remediated. A controllable viewer policy requires an owned custom domain and suitable certificate.

requirements.comment: These checks require legacy rejection and TLS 1.3 availability; they do not prove TLS 1.3-only operation. Hybrid PQ key exchange is measured per edge but not required globally: selection is provider-controlled, and one edge is known to negotiate the classical fallback. Set requirePqcHybridKex=true only after every measured edge selects X25519MLKEM768. The stricter TLS 1.3-only configuration target remains in post-quantum-policy.json and tls-config-readiness.mjs.

edges.label: backend edge (CloudFront)
edges.note: Fronts the backend API (AURA_BACKEND_ORIGIN). Observed 2026-10-16: TLS 1.0 and 1.1 both negotiated and served HTTP 200. With CloudFrontDefaultCertificate=true, AWS uses the TLS 1.0 viewer policy regardless of a claimed MinimumProtocolVersion. Do not lower minExpected to match this exposure. Measured 2026-11: pure X25519MLKEM768 handshake accepted independently of the viewer protocol floor.

edges.label: storefront (Netlify)
edges.note: Measured 2026-11: pure X25519MLKEM768 rejected; ordered X25519MLKEM768:X25519 fallback accepted and selected X25519. Provider currently does not select hybrid on this edge.
